updates.releaseTitle: Diamond Swarm - Elite AI Squadron - v1.6.1

changelog.title: Diamond Swarm Integration
changelog.description: Three specialized AI agents fine-tuned on VA claims: Auditor (legal analysis), Writer (statement generation), and Rater (disability assessment) - all running 100% locally

changelog.title: Wllama Browser Engine
changelog.description: New WASM-based AI backend runs entirely in your browser - no server required, works offline, maximum privacy

changelog.title: Local Server Support
changelog.description: Connect to llama.cpp, Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible local server - bring your own hardware for maximum power

changelog.title: Streamlined Model Selection
changelog.description: Removed 16 generic models to focus exclusively on Diamond Swarm agents - purpose-built for veteran claims, not generic chat

changelog.title: Optimized Bundle Size
changelog.description: Cleaned up legacy WebLLM model configurations - faster load times and reduced memory footprint

changelog.title: OCR-First Workflow
changelog.description: DD214 Analyzer now uses reliable OCR extraction before AI analysis - more accurate data extraction for all document types

changelog.title: Streamlined Model Selection
changelog.description: Removed experimental vision models to focus on stable, production-ready text models (Llama, Phi, Qwen, DeepSeek)

changelog.title: Cleaner Settings Interface
changelog.description: Simplified WebGPU configuration - removed experimental toggles for a more intuitive setup experience

changelog.title: DD214 Analyzer UX Fix
changelog.description: Analysis now automatically shows confirmation popup with extracted data - no more confusion about where data went

changelog.title: AI Badge Model Name
changelog.description: Fixed race condition causing wrong model name in status badge - now updates immediately when model loads

changelog.title: WebGPU Adapter Reinit
changelog.description: Fixed 'adapter consumed' error - experimental mode toggle now works without browser reload

changelog.title: Experimental Mode Crash
changelog.description: Fixed ReferenceError crash when accessing experimental mode settings

changelog.title: WGSL Shader Support
changelog.description: Added chromium_experimental_subgroup_matrix extension for u8 type support in WebLLM models

changelog.title: Local AI Setup Guide
changelog.description: Added comprehensive FAQ with Chrome flags instructions for Windows/Mac/Linux and troubleshooting steps
